name: Counterparty map
reader_question: Which counterparties hold distinct roles around one focal project?
relationship: An unweighted ego network: equal spokes link named counterparties to a focal entity. Angular order and distance carry no measure.
use_when: A single project is the common point of exposure across several contractual roles
The question concerns counterparties and roles rather than sequences or quantities
avoid_when: Amounts, direction or links among counterparties matter
Several hubs must be compared — use a role-matrix or edge list

data_contract.notes: Focal entity and the declared meaning of all links
4–8 unique counterparties; labels at most 28 characters, roles at most 44

units: No quantities. Spokes have equal weight. Radius and angle have no analytical meaning.

editable: Hub, unweighted spokes, counterparty names and roles
not_data_bound: Positioned shapes and lines; moving a label does not reconnect its spoke

table_alternative: An entity–role table with one row per counterparty.
variations: Group role types in the source table before laying out the spokes
limitations: Relationships are asserted by the input; the diagram does not independently verify them
No direction, flow, size, influence or hierarchy is encoded
Radial order is only for layout and is not a ranking

excluded_alternatives.reason: Suggests comparable quantitative scales for qualitative roles
Implies a direction and chain where only shared counterparties are established
